Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Iansan will not take fall DMG when using terrain differences to make leaps.

10000110.name: Caloric Balancing Plan
10000110.description: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, regain 10 Phlogiston when Phlogiston levels drop below 50%. This can occur once every 10s.

10000111.name: By the Horns
10000111.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Gotta try... to do battle like the greatest champion luchadors do! Varesa launches up to 3 strikes, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to headbutt opponents in front, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> and using the momentum to leap into the air.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> upon impact. If Varesa is in a combat state upon landing, or if the shockwave from her plunging attack hits an opponent, she will gain 25 Nightsoul points. She enters the Fiery Passion state upon reaching maximum Nightsoul points through this method.

<color=#FFD780FF>Fiery Passion</color>
In this state, Varesa's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will gain corresponding buffs:

<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Fight like a superstar champion luchador! Launches up to 3 fierce strikes, dealing greater <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to slam into her opponents, dealing greater amounts of Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> and using the momentum to leap into the air.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Consumes all her Nightsoul points and slams down on the ground from mid-air, dealing DMG to opponents in her path and dealing greater amounts of Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> upon hitting the ground.

parameterSeries.label: Fiery Passion Charged Attack Stamina Cost

10000111.name: Riding the Night-Rainbow
10000111.description: With footwork swift as lightning and fierce as thunder, Varesa displays the true spirit of lucha libre, rushing forward a certain distance and dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG to opponents in her path. After using this Skill, Varesa gains 20 Nightsoul points and gains the "Follow-Up Strike" effect: Varesa has increased interruption resistance during this time, and upon pressing her Normal Attack, she will quickly unleash a Charged Attack that does not consume Stamina. "Follow-Up Strike" will be canceled after Varesa uses a Charged Attack. She will use different techniques based on whether the skill is Tapped or Held. Tap Quickly rush a certain distance forward. Hold Varesa enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and switches to Sudden Onrush mode. Sudden Onrush Continuously consumes Nightsoul points. In this state, Varesa's Movement SPD and interruption resistance are increased. She can use terrain to execute flying leaps or consume additional Nightsoul points to traverse atop water or liquid Phlogiston while remaining immune to DMG from the latter. Nightsoul's Blessing: Varesa When she runs out of Nightsoul points, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will be canceled. When Varesa is in the Sudden Onrush state or Fiery Passion state, she will always be counted as being in the Nightsoul's Blessing state. Has 2 charges. When Varesa enters the Fiery Passion state, she will obtain an additional Tap charge of her Elemental Skill and its DMG will be increased. Fiery Passion · While not in the Fiery Passion state, Varesa can use Plunging Attacks to gain Nightsoul points. She will enter Fiery Passion when she reaches maximum Nightsoul points via this method, or when she uses her Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! · While in the Fiery Passion state, her Normal Attacks, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst will gain unique buffs. She can also use a special Elemental Burst shortly after using a Plunging Attack. · The Fiery Passion state lasts for up to 15s and will end when she runs out of Nightsoul points or after she leaves combat for a period of time. "Right now, I'm my own hero."

10000111.name: Guardian Vent!
10000111.description: Leaps into the air before using the momentum of the drop to unleash a powerful flying kick, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG to opponents — just like those heroes of justice in woven scrolls for kids! After using this Skill, Varesa's Nightsoul points will be restored to maximum and she will enter the Fiery Passion state. In the Fiery Passion state, Varesa's Elemental Burst will deal a greater amount of Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG. Additionally, she will briefly activate Apex Drive after using a Plunging Attack while in her Fiery Passion state. Apex Drive Increases Varesa's interruption resistance. While affected by Apex Drive, Varesa can ignore her Elemental Burst CD and consume less Energy to use her special Elemental Burst, "Guardian Vent: Volcano Kablam": This causes her to use the especially powerful Plunging Attack, the "Thunderous Tornado Eruption," which deals Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG upon landing before causing her to exit Apex Drive. This DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG. Varesa will exit Apex Drive after using her Elemental Skill. In truth, the original name Varesa gave this move was the "Invincible Dynamic Heroic Justice Super Mega Ultimate Thundercrash Sky-Splitting Supersonic Boom Kick." Alas, this name proved too long, and she was too embarrassed to shout it in front of everyone, even with her mask on. As such, she changed it to its present title instead.

10000111.name: Tag-Team Triple Jump!
10000111.description:
After using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Riding the Night-Rainbow</color>, Varesa gains "Rainbow Crash" for 5s.
During this time, when Varesa uses a Plunging Attack, the shockwave DMG dealt when she hits the ground is increased by 50% of her ATK. If Varesa is in the Fiery Passion state, this ground impact DMG is increased by 180% of her ATK instead.

The Rainbow Crash effect will be canceled once a ground impact hits an opponent, or when its duration expires.

10000111.name: The Hero Twice-Returned!
10000111.description: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Varesa's ATK increases by 35% for 12s. Max 2 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.

10000111.name: Night Realm's Gift: A Torch That Incinerates Evil
10000111.description:
After Nightsoul points have been fully depleted, Varesa will switch to using Phlogiston to maintain the Sudden Onrush mode from her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Nightsoul Transmission: Varesa can be used. When the current active character is sprinting or in movement modes caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, switching to Varesa will trigger the following: Varesa enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state, switches to Sudden Onrush mode, and obtains 20 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Varesa will not take fall DMG when using terrain differences to make leaps.

10000111.name: Blazing Heart, Singular Advance!
10000111.description:
Varesa's Sprint speed is increased. When she is not in combat, her Sprint Stamina consumption will also increase.
Additionally, while in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, your party members will restore 20 Phlogiston when consuming food. This effect can occur once every 10s and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

10000112.name: Kitchen Skills
10000112.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive spear strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an upward thrust.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000112.name: Low-Temperature Cooking
10000112.description:
Behold the true meaning of "cooking"! Escoffier will demonstrate different cooking techniques when you Tap or Hold this skill, but rest assured, each of them is Fontaine's pride and joy.

<color=#FFD780FF>Tap</color>
Activates her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek in its Cold Storage mode and deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to nearby opponents.

<color=#FFD780FF>Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode</color>
Follows the current active character and fires Frosty Parfaits at nearby opponents at intervals, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Arkhe: Ousia</color>
At intervals, Escoffier will summon a Surging Blade when activating her Cooking Mek in Cold Storage mode, dealing Ousia-aligned <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
Activates her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek's {LINK#N11120002}<color=#FFD780FF>Off-the-Cuff Cookery Mode</color>{/LINK}.

10000112.name: Scoring Cuts
10000112.description: Displaying her exceptional knife skills, Escoffier deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> and restores HP to all nearby party members based on her ATK.

10000112.name: Better to Salivate Than Medicate
10000112.description: After using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11125}Scoring Cuts{/LINK}</color>, Escoffier will obtain the Rehab Diet effect for 9s: Restores HP for nearby active characters every 1s based on 138.24% of Escoffier's ATK.

10000112.name: Inspiration-Immersed Seasoning
10000112.description: When there are 1/2/3/4 <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> characters in the party, Escoffier will decrease the <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro RES</color> and <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> of any opponents hit by her Elemental Skill, <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11122}Low-Temperature Cooking{/LINK}</color>, or her Elemental Burst, <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11125}Scoring Cuts{/LINK}</color>, by 5%/10%/15%/55% for 12s.

10000112.name: Constant Off-the-Cuff Cookery
10000112.description:
#When using the Hold form of her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11122}Low-Temperature Cooking{/LINK}</color>, Escoffier will activate her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek in its Off-the-Cuff Cookery mode.

<color=#FFD780FF>Cooking Mek: Off-the-Cuff Cookery Mode</color>
· Places the Cooking Mek on the field. The Cooking Mek can absorb elemental attacks. When the absorbed elemental energy hits a certain limit, Escoffier can convert the ingredients placed within it into wonderful food.
· Escoffier needs time to purchase new ingredients, so she can only make a certain number of dishes like this each week. The number of dishes Escoffier can make resets every Monday at 4:00 AM {TIMEZONE}.

10000113.name: Rite of Dispelling Winds
10000113.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 attacks, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and fires off a shot, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

10000113.name: Airborne Disease Prevention
10000113.description:
It's time for the real bash bros to step up! Ifa calls Cacucu in as backup.
After using this skill, Ifa gains 80 Nightsoul points and enters the {LINK#N11130003}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightsoul's Blessing</color>{/LINK} state. In the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Ifa will hover with Cacucu's help. When he uses Normal Attacks in this state, he will use different kinds of {LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>Supporting Fire</color>{/LINK} depending on whether you Tap or Hold, firing Tonicshots that are capable of healing all party members.

Additionally, Holding the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Airborne Disease Prevention</color> while Ifa is in Nightsoul's Blessing will cause him to use a Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Letting go of the skill button will interrupt this Plunging Attack to maintain his hover. If Ifa lands due to this Plunging Attack, his Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.

10000113.name: Compound Sedation Field
10000113.description:
Fires a Therapeutic Sedative at a (temporarily aggressive) opponent. The sedative will explode on impact, creating a restraining wind current that pulls nearby objects and opponents in while dealing Nightsoul-aligned <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>.
When the Therapeutic Sedative hits an opponent affected by <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>/<color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>/<color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>/<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, it will apply a {LINK#N11130004}<color=#FFD780FF>Sedation Mark</color>{/LINK} to them.

10000113.name: Field Medic's Vision
10000113.description: When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every 1 Nightsoul point out of the current total in his entire party will grant him 1 {LINK#N11130002}<color=#FFD780FF>Rescue Essentials</color>{/LINK} point. Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members.

10000113.name: Mutual Aid Agreement
10000113.description: When nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Ifa's Elemental Mastery increases by 80 for 10s.

10000113.name: Night Realm's Gift: Focused Emergency Rescue
10000113.description:
After his Nightsoul points are exhausted, Ifa will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain his Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Ifa. When the active character is a certain height in the air, the following will occur when switching to Ifa: Ifa will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 32 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.

10000113.name: Tactical Warm Compress Bandaging
10000113.description: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, when the current active party member or indwelt saurian has less than 40% HP, Ifa will consume 10 Phlogiston and restore 40% of their HP. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

10000114.name: Havoc: Sunder
10000114.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 5 consecutive attacks.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a spinning crystal spear, dealing DMG to opponents ahead.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000114.name: Havoc: Warp
10000114.description:
Imitates the combat style of "The Foul." Produces different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

<color=#FFD780FF>Tap</color>
Skirk gains 45 {LINK#N11130005}<color=#FFD780FF>Serpent's Subtlety</color>{/LINK} and switches to {LINK#N11130006}<color=#FFD780FF>Seven-Phase Flash</color>{/LINK} mode.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
Skirk gains 45 Serpent's Subtlety and will continuously move at high speed. Her interruption resistance is increased in this state.
During this time, Skirk can control her movement direction and move atop water. She can also use this Skill again to end rapid movement prematurely.

10000114.name: Havoc: Ruin
10000114.description:
Skirk's Elemental Burst is not reliant on Elemental Energy but instead on {LINK#N11130005}<color=#FFD780FF>Serpent's Subtlety</color>{/LINK}.
When Skirk has at least 50 Serpent's Subtlety, she can expend all her Serpent's Subtlety to unleash her Elemental Burst, ripping the space before her apart and using rapid consecutive slashes that deal <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. At the same time, the DMG dealt by an instance of this Elemental Burst will be increased by every point of Serpent's Subtlety over 50 when it is unleashed. Up to 12 points can be counted for this purpose.

When Skirk is in {LINK#N11130006}<color=#FFD780FF>Seven-Phase Flash</color>{/LINK} mode, Havoc: Ruin will be replaced by Havoc: Extinction.

<color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Extinction</color>
A special Elemental Burst that can be used even without consuming Serpent's Subtlety.
After using it, Skirk will gain the "All Shall Wither" effect, which will last until Seven-Phase Flash ends. After unlocking the Ascension Talent {LINK#N11130007}<color=#FFD780FF>Reason Beyond Reason</color>{/LINK}, she can also absorb nearby Void Rifts.
While "All Shall Wither" is active, every 0.1s, after Skirk's Normal Attack hits an opponent, that Normal Attack will deal increased DMG. If she absorbed any Void Rifts while using <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Extinction</color>, this Normal Attack's DMG will be further increased based on the number of Rifts absorbed.
This effect will be canceled when it has triggered 10 times.

10000114.name: Reason Beyond Reason
10000114.description:
When nearby party members trigger Frozen, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Cryo Swirl, Stellar Swirl, or Cryo Crystallize reactions against opponents, a Void Rift will be created near this opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 2.5s. 3 Void Rifts created by Skirk herself can exist on the field at once.

Skirk can use the following methods to absorb nearby Void Rifts:
· When she hits an opponent with a Charged Attack in her {LINK#N11130006}<color=#FFD780FF>Seven-Phase Flash</color>{/LINK} mode.
· When she uses the special Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Extinction</color> while in Seven-Phase Flash mode.
· When she Holds her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Warp</color> to engage in rapid movement.

Each Rift absorbed will grant her 8 {LINK#N11130005}<color=#FFD780FF>Serpent's Subtlety</color>{/LINK} points.

10000114.name: Return to Oblivion
10000114.description:
When nearby <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> party members' <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> attacks hit opponents, or when nearby <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> party members apart from Skirk hit opponents with <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> attacks, Skirk will gain the "Death's Crossing" effect for 20s. Max 3 stacks, each stack's duration is counted independently.
Each character can grant Skirk at most 1 "Death's Crossing" stack by this means.
Each "Death's Crossing" stack increases the Normal Attack DMG dealt by Skirk in {LINK#N11130006}<color=#FFD780FF>Seven-Phase Flash</color>{/LINK} mode to 110%/120%/170% of its original DMG and the DMG dealt when using her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Ruin</color> to 105%/115%/160% of its original DMG.

10000114.name: Mutual Weapons Mentorship
10000114.description: When all party members are either <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>, and if there is at least 1 Hydro and 1 Cryo character, your own party members' <color=#FFD780FF>Elemental Skill</color> Level is increased by 1.

10000115.name: Favonius Bladework - Ritual
10000115.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000115.name: Immersive Ordinance
10000115.description:
Time for a fun little trick! Summons the Sacramental Shower in different ways depending on whether you Tap or Hold it.

<color=#FFD780FF>Tap</color>
After a short prayer, summons the Sacramental Shower in front.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
Engages in continuous prayer, and when done, summons forth a Sacramental Shower in the designated position.

<color=#FFD780FF>Sacramental Shower</color>
When opponents or nearby party members touch the Sacramental Shower, different effects will occur depending on the one who touches it:
If an opponent touches the Shower, it will explode and deal <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> to nearby opponents.
If a nearby party member touches it, it will bounce the one who touches it high in the air.

Only 1 Sacramental Shower summoned by Dahlia himself can be on the field at once.

10000115.name: Radiant Psalter
10000115.description:
Appeals to the divine with earnestness and song, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> to nearby opponents and granting his party members Favonian Favor, summoning a Shield of Sacred Favor.
The Shield of Sacred Favor's DMG absorption is based on Dahlia's Max HP, and it will absorb <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> with 250% effectiveness.

<color=#FFD780FF>Favonian Favor</color>
While this effect is active, 1 Benison stack may be consumed to summon a new Shield of Sacred Favor when an existing Shield is broken via DMG.

Dahlia can obtain Benison via the following methods:
· He will gain 1 Benison stack when his own active party member hits opponents 4 times with Normal Attacks while affected by Favonian Favor.
· After triggering the effect of his Ascension Talent, "The Wind's Gentle Grace" (You must first unlock this Ascension Talent.)
Dahlia can gain a maximum of 4 Benison stacks per Favonian Favor duration.

parameterSeries.label: Shield of Sacred Favor DMG Absorption

10000115.name: The Wind's Gentle Grace
10000115.description: When characters affected by the Favonian Favor effect of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color> trigger Frozen reactions on opponents, they will grant Dahlia 2 Benison stacks. This effect can trigger once every 8s.

10000115.name: Prayer of Well-Wrought Joy
10000115.description: When your active party member is affected by the Favonian Favor effect of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}"Radiant Psalter,"{/LINK}</color> their ATK SPD will increase based on Dahlia's Max HP: Every 1,000 Max HP will cause an increase of 0.5%, up to a maximum of 20%.

10000115.name: Pilgrimage Upon Returning Winds
10000115.description:
During the day (06:00 – 18:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.

10000116.name: Cyclonic Duster
10000116.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a spinning attack.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000116.name: Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency
10000116.description:
Ineffa engages her Enhanced Cleaning Module, dealing a single instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to nearby opponents, activating her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, and summoning the Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit, {LINK#N11160001}<color=#FFD780FF>Birgitta</color>{/LINK}.
The Optical Flow Shield Barrier absorbs DMG based on Ineffa's ATK, and it will absorb <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> with 250% effectiveness.

10000116.name: Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator
10000116.description:
Through Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit, {LINK#N11160001}<color=#FFD780FF>Birgitta</color>{/LINK}, Ineffa can use Rocket Punches to quickly clean up opponents! Shoots Birgitta into the fray, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and allowing Birgitta to remain on the field.

If Birgitta is already on the field, having been summoned by Ineffa, this Skill will re-summon Birgitta at the target's location and reset her duration.

10000116.name: Overclocking Circuit
10000116.description: If there are thunderclouds created by Lunar-Charged reactions nearby when {LINK#N11160001}<color=#FFD780FF>Birgitta</color>{/LINK} unleashes Discharge attacks, she will initiate an additional attack, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> equal to 65% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.

10000116.name: Panoramic Permutation Protocol
10000116.description: When using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11165}Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator{/LINK}</color>, all your party members will gain the Parameter Permutation effect: Increases Ineffa and your own active party member's Elemental Mastery by 6% of Ineffa's ATK for 20s.

10000116.name: Moonsign Benediction: Assemblage Hub
10000116.description:
When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Ineffa has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Ineffa is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

10000116.name: Flavor Synthesis Unit
10000116.description:
When Ineffa uses food, there is a 30% chance of gaining a seasoning ingredient.

Additionally, in Nod-Krai, it seems you'll be able to change Birgitta's appearance through certain means...

10000119.name: Peregrination of Linnunrata
10000119.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 attacks that deal <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Lauma undergoes Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis, transforming into an envoy of the tranquil forest and consuming Stamina to charge forward for up to 10s. While in this state, Lauma's interruption resistance is increased, and she can consume additional Stamina to perform up to two consecutive jumps.
When exiting the Spirit Envoy state, Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis will enter cooldown, during which time, Lauma's Charged Attack will be transformed into Spiritcall Prayer: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Calling upon the might of Dendro, Lauma plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path and dealing <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

parameterSeries.label: Spirit Envoy Form Movement Stamina Cost
Spirit Envoy Form Jumping Stamina Cost

10000119.name: Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko
10000119.description:
Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a {LINK#N11190001}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostgrove Sanctuary</color>{/LINK} with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

<color=#FFD780FF>Tap</color>
Intone a Hymn of Hunting, dealing <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 {LINK#N11190008}<color=#FFD780FF>Verdant Dew</color>{/LINK}. Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> and another instance of <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of {LINK#N11190002}<color=#FFD780FF>Moon Song</color>{/LINK}. Each time you Hold to cast an Elemental Skill, a maximum of 3 Verdant Dew can be consumed in this way.

Additionally, when Lauma's Elemental Skill or attacks from Frostgrove Sanctuary hit an opponent, that opponent's <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> and <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro RES</color> will be decreased for 10s.

10000119.name: Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon
10000119.description:
Let the wishes of all beings become as moonlight that bathes the earth. Lauma incants a sacred song of the far north, gaining 18 stacks of {LINK#N11190003}<color=#FFD780FF>Pale Hymn</color>{/LINK}.
Additionally, if Lauma uses her Elemental Burst while she has {LINK#N11190002}<color=#FFD780FF>Moon Song</color>{/LINK}, or she gains Moon Song within 15s of using her Elemental Burst, she will consume all Moon Song stacks and gain 6 stacks of Pale Hymn for every Moon Song stack consumed. This effect can only be triggered once for each Elemental Burst used, including the 15 seconds following its use.

<color=#FFD780FF>Pale Hymn</color>
When nearby party members deal Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom DMG, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed and the DMG dealt will be increased based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery. If this DMG hits multiple opponents at once, then multiple stacks of Pale Hymn will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.
The duration for each stack of Pale Hymn is counted independently.

parameterSeries.label: Pale Hymn Stacks Gained From Elemental Burst
Moon Song to Pale Hymn Conversion
Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG Increase

10000119.name: Light for the Frosty Night
10000119.description:
For the next 20s after Lauma uses her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11192}Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko{/LINK}</color>, corresponding differing buff effects will be granted depending on the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color>. The buffs provided by different Moonsign levels cannot stack.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Nascent Gleam</color>
Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG dealt by all nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 15%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>
All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG CRIT Rate +10%, CRIT DMG +20%.

10000119.name: Cleansing for the Spring
10000119.description:
Each point of Elemental Mastery Lauma has will give her the following bonuses:
· DMG dealt by her Elemental Skill is increased by 0.04%. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 32%.
· The cooldown of her Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis</color> is reduced by 0.02%. The maximum reduction obtainable this way is 20%.

10000119.name: Moonsign Benediction: Nature's Chorus
10000119.description:
When a Bloom reaction is triggered by a party member, it will be converted into the Lunar-Bloom reaction, with every point of Elemental Mastery that Lauma has increasing Lunar-Bloom's Base DMG by 0.0175%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Lauma is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

10000119.name: Prayers for the Forest
10000119.description:
Displays the location of nearby <color=#FFD780FF>resources unique to Nod-Krai</color> on the mini-map.
Additionally, Lauma appears to have a special affinity with some small animals affected by kuuvahki...

10000120.name: Pocztowy Demonspear
10000120.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward spear throw.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000120.name: Ancient Rite: Arcane Light
10000120.description:
Flins summons forth the ancient power concealed within his lamp and switches to his <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Flame</color> form. This form has the following characteristics:
· Flins's Normal and Charged Attacks deal <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> that cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions, and he is unable to perform Plunging Attacks.
· His interruption resistance is increased.
· His Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Rite: Arcane Light</color> is replaced with the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color>
Flins summons a flurry of spears in front, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and causing his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night</color> to be replaced with the special Elemental Burst {LINK#N11200001}<color=#FFD780FF>Thunderous Symphony</color>{/LINK} for the next 6s.
The base CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color> is 6s and will not be affected by other effects.

10000120.name: Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night
10000120.description:
Flins unleashes the true power of his lamp, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and, after a short delay, dealing 2 instances of middle-phase and 1 instance of final-phase <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>, all of which are considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional 2 instances of middle-phase Lunar-Charged <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>.

After using the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color>, Flins's Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night</color> will be replaced with the special Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderous Symphony</color> for the next 6s.

<color=#FFD780FF>Thunderous Symphony</color>
Consume less Elemental Energy to unleash a special Elemental Burst. Flins deals a single instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> that is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional instance of Lunar-Charged <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>.

10000120.name: Symphony of Winter
10000120.description:
Flins will gain a corresponding buff effect based on the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Lunar-Charged reactions triggered by Flins will deal an additional 20% DMG.

10000120.name: Whispering Flame
10000120.description: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 160.

10000120.name: Moonsign Benediction: Old World Secrets
10000120.description:
When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Flins has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Flins is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

10000120.name: A Light in the Dark
10000120.description:
Displays the location of nearby <color=#FFD780FF>resources unique to Nod-Krai</color> on the mini-map.
Additionally, Flins appears to be able to decipher the whispers of the Wild Hunt...

10000121.name: Bish-Bash-Bosh Repair
10000121.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000121.name: Musecatcher
10000121.description:
Aino throws a <color=#FFD780FF>Musecatcher</color> forward, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> and dragging her along behind it. When the dragging stops, Aino deals <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> to nearby opponents.
Holding the Skill will cause it to behave differently.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
Enter Aiming Mode to adjust the Musecatcher's throwing direction.

10000121.name: Precision Hydronic Cooler
10000121.description:
Aino deploys a custom water-spraying device, the <color=#FFD780FF>Cool Your Jets Ducky</color> to establish a <color=#FFD780FF>Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone</color>.
While active, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will periodically fire water balls at nearby opponents, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>.

10000121.name: Modular Efficiency Protocol
10000121.description:
Aino will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: The <color=#FFD780FF>Cool Your Jets Ducky</color> will fire water balls more frequently, and the water balls will deal <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> over a larger area of effect.

10000121.name: Structured Power Booster
10000121.description: Aino's Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 50% of her Elemental Mastery.

10000121.name: Moonsign Benediction: Force Limit Analysis
10000121.description: When Aino is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

10000121.name: Miniaturized Detection Sensor
10000121.description:
Displays the location of nearby <color=#FFD780FF>resources unique to Nod-Krai</color> on the mini-map.
Additionally, Aino appears to be able to alter the Cool Your Jets Ducky's appearance in some way...

10000122.name: Striking Serpent
10000122.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 kicks that deal <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> with the ferocity and grace of a striking serpent.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Nefer enters the Slither state, consuming Stamina to move rapidly forward for up to 2.5s. When the skill button is released, the duration ends, or Stamina runs out, Nefer will exit the Slither state and consume a certain amount of additional Stamina to deal <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> to opponents. When in the {LINK#N11220001}<color=#FFD780FF>Shadow Dance</color>{/LINK} state, additional Stamina consumption is decreased.
Additionally, unleashing the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11222}Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights{/LINK}</color> or sprinting while Nefer is in the Slither state will not cause her to exit the state.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Calling upon the might of Dendro, Nefer plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path and dealing <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

parameterSeries.label: Shadow Dance Charged Attack Stamina Cost

10000122.name: Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights
10000122.description: A dance that dissolved dynasties, as chilling as a winter's night on the great sea of sand, yet lingering with the tenderness of moonlit gauze. Nefer charges forward, dealing AoE Dendro DMG and entering the {LINK#N11220001}Shadow Dance{/LINK} state. While in the Shadow Dance state, if you have at least 1 {LINK#N11190008}Verdant Dew{/LINK}, Nefer's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack {LINK#N11220002}Phantasm Performance{/LINK}, which will not consume Stamina. When in the Shadow Dance state, Nefer's resistance to interruption is increased. Two initial charges. "The world is a game in which the pieces remain hidden behind a veil. To avoid falling into a trap, one must collect every piece of information one can. This is the meaning of secrets."

10000122.name: Sacred Vow: True Eye's Phantasm
10000122.description: Grant "revelation" to the mysteries of the false through Thoth's true sight, dealing AoE Dendro DMG to opponents ahead. When unleashed, Nefer will consume all {LINK#N11220003}Veils of Falsehood{/LINK} to increase the DMG dealt by the current Elemental Burst. The blessings of the Ibis King proclaimed by the singers of the burning sands are, in truth, more akin to dire curses.

10000122.name: A Wager of Moonlight
10000122.description:
Nefer will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: When she unleashes her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11222}Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights{/LINK}</color>, any Dendro Cores on the field will be converted to Seeds of Deceit, and any Lunar-Bloom reactions triggered by nearby characters in the following 15s that would create Dendro Cores or Bountiful Cores will instead create Seeds of Deceit. Seeds of Deceit cannot trigger Hyperbloom or Burgeon reactions and will not burst.
When Nefer unleashes a Charged Attack or {LINK#N11220002}<color=#FFD780FF>Phantasm Performance</color>{/LINK}, she can absorb Seeds of Deceit within a certain range, gaining 1 stack of {LINK#N11220003}<color=#FFD780FF>Veil of Falsehood</color>{/LINK} for every seed absorbed. When this effect reaches 3 stacks, or when the third stack's duration is refreshed, Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100 for 8s.

10000122.name: Daughter of the Dust and Sand
10000122.description: When Nefer is in the {LINK#N11220001}<color=#FFD780FF>Shadow Dance</color>{/LINK} state, for 5s after a party member triggers a Lunar-Bloom reaction, Nefer's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11221}Slither{/LINK}</color> state will provide additional {LINK#N11190008}<color=#FFD780FF>Verdant Dew</color>{/LINK}. Every 100 points of Nefer's Elemental Mastery beyond 500 will strengthen this additional provision effect by 10%. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 50%.

10000122.name: Moonsign Benediction: Dusklit Eaves
10000122.description:
When a party member triggers a Bloom reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Bloom reaction, with every point of Elemental Mastery that Nefer has increasing Lunar-Bloom's Base DMG by 0.0175%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Nefer is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

10000122.name: Conspiracy of the Golden Vault
10000122.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Nod-Krai Expedition for 20 hours.

10000123.name: Radiant Wingslash
10000123.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a slash toward the front.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000123.name: Binary Form: Convergence and Division
10000123.description:
Purify the substance of souls and wishes to undergo {LINK#N11230001}<color=#FFD780FF>Essential Transmutation</color>{/LINK}. While transmuted, Durin's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Binary Form: Convergence and Division</color> will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Transmutation: Confirmation of Purity</color>, and the Normal Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Radiant Wingslash</color> will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Transmutation: Denial of Darkness</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Transmutation: Confirmation of Purity</color>
Deal 1 instance of <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> to nearby opponents, reverse Essential Transmutation, and enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Confirmation of Purity</color> state for 30s.

<color=#FFD780FF>Transmutation: Denial of Darkness</color>
Deal 3 consecutive instances of <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> to opponents in front, reverse Essential Transmutation, and enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Denial of Darkness</color> state for 30s.

When Durin enters the <color=#FFD780FF>Confirmation of Purity</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Denial of Darkness</color> state while in battle, he will restore a certain amount of Elemental Energy. Elemental Energy can be restored this way once every 6s.

10000123.name: Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts
10000123.description:
Unleash the power of the "Beast" in different ways. Durin can use different Elemental Bursts based on his {LINK#N11230001}<color=#FFD780FF>Essential Transmutation</color>{/LINK} state.

<color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts</color>
When Durin is in the <color=#FFD780FF>Confirmation of Purity</color> state, he will use the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts</color>, dealing 3 instances of <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> to opponents in front, and manifesting his power in the <color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of White Flame</color> form. The Dragon of White Flame will follow the current active character and attack nearby opponents at intervals, dealing <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

<color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder</color>
When Durin is in the <color=#FFD780FF>Denial of Darkness</color> state, he will use the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder</color>, dealing 3 instances of <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> to opponents in front, and manifesting his power in the <color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of Dark Decay</color> form. The Dragon of Dark Decay will follow the current active character and periodically attack a single nearby opponent, dealing <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

When Durin is not in a special state as a result of Essential Transmutation, he will use the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts</color>.

parameterSeries.label: Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts DMG
Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder DMG

10000123.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Ode to Ascension
10000123.description:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: Of This World</color>, Durin will become a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
Increases all effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#P1232101}<color=#FFD780FF>Light Manifest of the Divine Calculus</color>{/LINK} (except for Duration) by 75%.

10000123.name: Light Manifest of the Divine Calculus
10000123.description:
Durin will trigger different buffs depending on the form that his power manifests as when he unleashes his Elemental Burst. When that form is:

<color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of White Flame</color>
After nearby party members trigger Burning, Overloaded, Pyro Swirl, or Pyro Crystallize reactions on an opponent, or deal <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> or <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> to an opponent affected by Burning, that opponent's <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro RES</color>, and the RES for the corresponding Element involved in the reaction, are decreased by 20% for 6s.

<color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of Dark Decay</color>
Durin's Vaporize DMG is increased by 40% and his Melt DMG is increased by 40%.

10000123.name: Chaos Formed Like the Night
10000123.description:
After unleashing an Elemental Burst, Durin gains the Primordial Fusion of Forms effect for 20s: Durin gains 10 stacks of Primordial Fusion. When a periodic attack from <color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of White Flame</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of Dark Decay</color> deals DMG, 1 stack of Primordial Fusion will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 3% of the original DMG for every 100 ATK. A maximum of 75% additional DMG can be dealt this way. When a single attack from <color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of White Flame</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of Dark Decay</color> hits multiple opponents, only one stack of Primordial Fusion is consumed.
Primordial Fusion stacks are reset when the Elemental Burst is unleashed again.

10000123.name: Echoes of the Surging Earth
10000123.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Mondstadt Expedition for 20 hours.

10000124.name: Strike While the Arrow's Hot
10000124.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Performs a more precise <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color> with increased DMG.
While aiming, mighty winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000124.name: Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils
10000124.description: Jahoda dashes toward her opponent, entering the Shadow Pursuit state upon contact. While in this state, Jahoda moves continuously and swiftly: If nearby opponents are affected by Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo, she will quietly convert her {LINK#N11240001}Purr-loined Treasure Flask{/LINK} to that element, gradually filling it. When the duration ends or the skill is used again, Jahoda drains the Purr-loined Treasure Flask and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask is full, Jahoda immediately drains it, exiting the Shadow Pursuit state and dealing a more powerful instance of Anemo DMG. If her dash fails to make contact with an opponent, Jahoda instead drops a Smoke Bomb at her location, dealing a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask becomes full, Jahoda will not immediately discharge it. Instead, for a short duration, she steadily consumes the stored element inside and periodically fires Fluffy Meowballs at nearby opponents, dealing DMG of the corresponding element stored in the Purr-loined Treasure Flask. When a Fluffy Meowball hits an opponent, Jahoda regenerates 2 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 3.5s. There are many ways to divide wealth in this world — but for Nod-Krai's treasure hunters — and hoarders — only one has ever proven sufficiently effective.

10000124.name: Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter
10000124.description: Time to reveal those pocket aces! Jahoda retrieves 2 {LINK#N11240002}Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots{/LINK} and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. "Coordinated assistance? It means you 'assist' some Mora our way, and we handle the 'coordination.' Makes purrfect sense, don't you agree?"

10000124.name: Plan to Get Paid
10000124.description:
When your team has at least one <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> character, the {LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter</color> will be enhanced based on the number of characters of each corresponding element.
Jahoda secretly keeps track of these characters. Among them, the element with the highest number of characters determines the enhancement effect:
· <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>: <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> deal 130% of their original DMG.
· <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>: <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> heal for 120% of their original healing amount.
· <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>: The number of <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> increases by one.
· <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>: The attack interval of <color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> is reduced by 10%.

If there's a tie between elements, the order of priority that determines which enhancement takes effect is: <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, then <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>. Only one elemental effect can initially be triggered.

10000124.name: Sweet Berry Bounty
10000124.description: When a {LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter</color> triggers healing on an active team member, if that character's HP is above 70%, their Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100 for 6s.

10000124.name: Moonsign Benediction: Rooftop Dash
10000124.description: When Jahoda is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

10000124.name: Backstreet Guile
10000124.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Nod-Krai, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

10000125.name: Moondew Cascade
10000125.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Summons Moonlit Tides, performing up to 3 attacks that deal <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> after a short casting time.
If you have at least 1 {LINK#N11190008}<color=#FFD780FF>Verdant Dew</color>{/LINK}, Columbina's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Moondew Cleanse</color>, which will not consume Stamina: Consume 1 Verdant Dew to deal 3 instances of <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> to opponents in front. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

10000125.name: Eternal Tides
10000125.description:
Awaken Moonbound Tides, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> and summoning {LINK#N11250001}<color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Ripple</color>{/LINK}.
<color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Ripple</color> will follow the active character on the field, while continuously dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> to surrounding opponents. While <color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Ripple</color> is on the field, and nearby party members trigger Lunar reactions or inflict Lunar Reaction DMG, Columbina will accrue a special <color=#FFD780FF>Gravity</color>. Once Gravity is accumulated to its limit, different types of damage will be dealt to enemies based on the type of Lunar Reaction that has accumulated the most <color=#FFD780FF>Gravity</color> for Columbina.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: <color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Ripple</color> inflicts <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> over a wider area.

10000125.name: Moonlit Melancholy
10000125.description: Hills and tides unite under the silver light of a pristine new moon. Temporarily transforms the surrounding terrain into {LINK#N11250002}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Domain</color>{/LINK}, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF> AoE Hydro DMG</color>.

10000125.name: Lunacy's Lure
10000125.description: When triggering {LINK#N11250001}<color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Interference</color>{/LINK}, Columbina gains the Lunacy effect, increasing her CRIT Rate by 5% for 10s. This effect can be stacked up to 3 times.

10000125.name: Law of the New Moon
10000125.description:
When characters within the {LINK#N11250002}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Domain</color>{/LINK} trigger Lunar reactions, they will gain the following effects respectively: 
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Charged</color>: When the Thundercloud performs lightning strike(s) against a valid target, it has a 33% chance to perform an additional lightning strike. 
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Bloom</color>: When triggering Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party gains a special {LINK#N11250003}<color=#FFD780FF>Moonridge Dew</color>{/LINK}. Up to 3 Moonridge Dews can be gained every 18s. 
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Crystallize</color>: When Moondrift Harmony is triggered, every Moondrift has a 33% chance to inflict an extra attack.

10000125.name: Moonsign Benediction: Moonlight, Lent Unto You
10000125.description:
When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged, Bloom, or Hydro-Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into a Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, or Lunar-Crystallize reaction respectively. Lunar Reaction DMG inflicted by party members gain a Base DMG increase based on Columbina's Max HP. For every 1,000 points of Max HP, the Base DMG of Lunar reactions is increased by 0.2%, up to a maximum of 7%.

Additionally, when Columbina is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

10000125.name: Lunar Vigil
10000125.description:
If one of your party members is incapacitated while in the Nod-Krai or Frost Moon regions, Columbina will revive this character. The amount of HP the character will have upon revival is based on Columbina's Friendship Level. This effect can occur once every 100s. This effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
Additionally, Columbina appears to have a special affinity for certain animals who are influenced by kuuvahki...

10000126.name: Golden Blade's Petaled Touch
10000126.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000126.name: Heaven and Earth Made Manifest
10000126.description:
Summoning a shadow of her former powers, she switches to the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode.
In this mode, Zibai's Normal Attacks and Charged Attacks will deal <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> that cannot be overridden by other infusions, and she can accrue special <color=#FFD780FF>Phase Shift Radiance</color> through different methods. Zibai can consume Phase Shift Radiance to unleash the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>
While in the <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color> mode, when Zibai performs Normal Attacks, the fourth attack will deal an additional instance of <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color>, which is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

parameterSeries.label: Lunar Phase Shift Charged Attack DMG

10000126.name: Tri-Sphere Eminence
10000126.description:
Zibai operates the Jadelight Canopy, dealing two instances of <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color>, with the second damage instance being considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
When cast, if Zibai is in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK}, the duration of the current Lunar Phase Shift will extend by an additional 1.7s.

10000126.name: The Selenic Adeptus Descends
10000126.description: When casting the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}Heaven and Earth Made Manifest{/LINK}</color>, or when nearby party members trigger Moondrift Harmony, Zibai gains the <color=#FFD780FF>Selenic Descent</color> effect for 4s: The DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color>{/LINK} is increased by 60% of Zibai's DEF.

10000126.name: Layered Peaks Pierce the Clouds
10000126.description: Other <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> party members increase Zibai's DEF by 15% each. <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> party members increase her Elemental Mastery by 60 each.

10000126.name: Moonsign Benediction: The Coursing Sun and Moon
10000126.description:
When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Zibai has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Zibai is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

10000126.name: Moonlit Flower Forest
10000126.description:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), when not in combat, restore 1 Elemental Energy to Zibai every 2 seconds.
This effect does not work in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

10000127.name: Oathkeeper's Spear
10000127.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000127.name: Dawnbearing Songbird
10000127.description:
Summons the trusty messenger bird, "Aedon." Different effects are produced depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

<color=#FFD780FF>Tap</color>
Aedon dashes towards enemies in front, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to enemies it comes into contact with.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
Enter aiming mode, and command Aedon to dash towards opponents being aimed at, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to opponents it comes into contact with.

10000127.name: Shadowless Reflection
10000127.description:
Light the lamp, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>AoE Geo DMG</color>, and gain Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect for 20s. When this effect is active, Illuga gains 21 stacks of {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightingale's Song</color>{/LINK}. When Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts of nearby active party members deal <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to opponents, 1 stack of Nightingale's Song is consumed to increase the DMG dealt. Increase in DMG is based on Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If DMG is inflicted by Lunar-Crystallize, DMG dealt will increase further.
When <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> dealt in this manner hits multiple opponents, multiple stacks of Nightingale's Song will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.

Additionally, if there are <color=#FFE699FF>Geo Constructs</color> created by nearby party members on the battlefield while Illuga unleashes his Elemental Burst, or when nearby party members create <color=#FFE699FF>Geo Constructs</color> while Haunted Night's Oriole-Song is active, every <color=#FFE699FF>Geo Construct</color> on the battlefield will allow Illuga to gain 5 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song. Within 20s after unleashing his Elemental Burst, Illuga can gain a maximum of 15 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song this way.

When all stacks of Nightingale's Song have been consumed, or when the state's duration ends, the Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect will end.

parameterSeries.label: Nightingale's Song Stacks Gained from Elemental Burst
Nightingale's Song Stacks Gained from Geo Constructs

10000127.name: Torchforger's Covenant
10000127.description:
After unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11272}Dawnbearing Songbird{/LINK}</color> or Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}Shadowless Reflection{/LINK}</color>, other nearby party members will gain the Lightkeeper's Oath effect for 20s: For <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate increases by 5% and CRIT DMG increases by 10%.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color> 
Party members affected by the Lightkeeper's Oath effect have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50.

10000127.name: Demonhunter's Dusk
10000127.description: {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightingale's Song</color>{/LINK}'s effects are enhanced: When there are 1/2/3 <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> or <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> characters in the party, Nightingale's Song will further increase DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 7%/14%/24% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If this aforementioned DMG is inflicted by a Lunar-Crystallize reaction, increase in DMG is equal to 48%/96%/160% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery.

10000127.name: Moonsign Benediction: Unwithering in Winter
10000127.description: When Illuga is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

10000127.name: Night Warden's Stride
10000127.description:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.
Additionally, Illuga appears to be able to decipher the whispers of the Wild Hunt...

10000128.name: Favonius Bladework: Dancing Radiance
10000128.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Imitating an ancient knightly war-dance, Varka wields dual claymores to perform up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to charge forward and perform an especially powerful dual blade slash toward the front.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000128.name: Windbound Execution
10000128.description:
Manifest the true essence of Favonius Bladework with absolute power. Produces different effects depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

<color=#FFD780FF>Tap</color>
Leap forward and slash in one fluid motion, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> and switching to {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK} mode.
While in <color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>, Varka's Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG is increased, and he cannot perform Plunging Attacks. Also, when performing Normal or Charged Attacks, Varka's dual-wielded claymores will deal corresponding Elemental DMG based on the Elemental Types of the characters in the party, respectively. This Elemental DMG cannot be overridden by infusions.
Additionally, when in <color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>, if there are <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> characters in the party, Varka's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Windbound Execution</color> will be converted to the special Elemental Skill, {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, dealing corresponding Elemental DMG and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>. Additionally, Varka can also expend uses of the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> to perform a special Charged Attack, <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, that does not consume stamina to deal corresponding Elemental DMG and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
After charging for a while, leap forward. The duration of the charge will increase the distance of the leap.

parameterSeries.label: Sturm und Drang Charged Attack DMG

10000128.name: Northwind Avatar
10000128.description:
In the name of the mightiest Knight of Boreas, unleash a powerful double slash attack toward the front, dealing 2 instances of <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.
If there are <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> characters in the party, the first slash will be converted to deal corresponding Elemental DMG according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types.

10000128.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Dawn's Return
10000128.description:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: The Untitled Question</color>, Varka will become a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
Enhances the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}: When Varka hits an opponent with Normal Attack(s) in {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK}, the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> will be reduced by 1s.

10000128.name: Dawn Wind's March
10000128.description:
When there are <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> characters in the party, according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types, every 1,000 points of Varka's ATK will grant Varka a 10% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG Bonus</color> and corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus (among the aforementioned Elemental Types, only one element can gain bonus DMG this way). Up to 25% bonus DMG can be gained this way. 

Additionally, if there are at least 2 <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color> characters, or at least 2 characters of the same Element among <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> in the party, the Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color> and the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK} that Varka deals or unleashes while in the {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK} mode will deal 140% of their original DMG. If there are at least 2 <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color> characters and at least 2 other characters of the same element among <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> present in the party at the same time, the aforementioned effect will be increased to 220%.

10000128.name: Wind's Vanguard
10000128.description: When nearby party members trigger a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, Varka gains 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color>, increasing the DMG dealt by his Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color> and special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK} by 7.5% for 8s. Max 4 stacks. Each character can grant Varka with 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> every second this way.

10000128.name: Homebound Wind's Paean
10000128.description:
For every party member from Mondstadt, the Hold version of Varka's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Windbound Execution</color>'s CD is decreased by 5%.
This effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

10000129.name: Spear of Favonius — Broken Oath
10000129.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward thrust.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000129.name: Unforeseen Strike
10000129.description: As he searches for weaknesses, Lohen switches to {LINK#N11290001}Masterstroke{/LINK} mode. While in this state: · Lohen can actively accumulate {LINK#N11290003}Joy{/LINK}, using it to unleash the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}Etched Into Bone and Soul{/LINK}. · Nearby party members can accumulate {LINK#N11290004}Will to Win{/LINK} for Lohen, increasing the DMG dealt by Etched Into Bone and Soul. Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul up to 3 times while in Masterstroke mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate Joy. "Chivalry? Hah, what better way to bait the trap? When an enemy dreams of an honorable victory, they inevitably fail to suspect the 'pleasant surprise' that awaits them."

parameterSeries.label: Etched Into Bone and Soul DMG
DMG Increase From Will to Win

10000129.name: Manifest Judgment
10000129.description: Performs a swift series of forward strikes, consuming all {LINK#N11290004}Will to Win{/LINK} and dealing Cryo DMG. This DMG will be increased based on the amount of Will to Win consumed. If Lohen is in {LINK#N11290001}Masterstroke{/LINK} mode when this is performed, the duration of Masterstroke will be extended by 1.65s. "So quick to cave? What a pity, I was just starting to enjoy myself..."

parameterSeries.label: DMG Increase From Will to Win

10000129.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Unhealing Thorn
10000129.description:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: Of Various Foes</color>, Lohen becomes a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
When the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} hits an opponent or the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> is unleashed, if Lohen's {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} is at 50% or more of its max limit, his Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG will be increased by 40% for 6s.

10000129.name: Moratorium on Questioning
10000129.description: When nearby party members accumulate {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} for Lohen by dealing DMG while he is in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, if that DMG is not less than 3,000% of Lohen's Base ATK, it will accumulate an extra 60 <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>.

10000129.name: Flippant Masterpiece
10000129.description: While in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, for 8s after another nearby party member triggers a <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo Reaction</color>, that character's ATK is increased by 15%, while Lohen's ATK is increased by 15%.

10000129.name: When the Mood Strikes
10000129.description:
Lohen gains "High Spirits" for 9s after he unleashes the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Unforeseen Strike</color>: Increases the Skill Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Unforeseen Strike</color> by 1.
When unleashing an Elemental Skill, if the Level of any other party member's Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst is not lower than Lohen's Elemental Skill Level, the duration of this instance of High Spirits will be increased by an additional 6s.
High Spirits can be gained once every 18s.

10000130.name: Capture Protocol
10000130.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Performs a more precise <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color> with increased DMG.
While aiming, stone crystals will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged crystalline arrow will deal <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000130.name: Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!
10000130.description: Adventure with Lumi! Depending on how you Tap, Lumi attacks in different forms. Tap Lumi strikes in a {LINK#N11300001}Super Power Form{/LINK}, attacking nearby enemies continuously, dealing AoE Geo DMG. If there are Moondrifts nearby, Lumi will also deal AoE Geo DMG to nearby enemies, which will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG. Continuous Tapping Time to show what we're really capable of! After using her Elemental Skill, Linnea will feed Lumi sparkling gemstones when her Elemental Skill or Normal Attack is Tapped repeatedly. A full-bellied Lumi will strike in her {LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}, dealing an especially powerful instance of AoE Geo DMG that is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, switching to {LINK#N11300001}Standard Power Form{/LINK}. Additionally, tapping the Elemental Skill increases Linnea's interruption resistance. "You're up, Lumi!"

10000130.name: Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions
10000130.description: Even master adventurers need proper rest! Linnea summons Lumi to strike in {LINK#N11300001}Super Power Form{/LINK}, healing nearby party members. For a short duration, she will continuously heal nearby active party members based on Linnea's DEF. If Lumi is already on the field when Linnea unleashes Elemental Burst, Lumi's active duration will be reset instead and her Strike Form will not change. "Any professional adventurer worth their salt prizes making it out of a serious jam over making discoveries, however unprecedented!"

10000130.name: Field Observation Notes
10000130.description:
When Lumi is present on the field, the <color=#FFE699FF>Geo RES</color> of opponents near Lumi will decrease by 15%.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Linnea's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color> and Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11305}Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions{/LINK}</color> are enhanced. After summoning Lumi, the <color=#FFE699FF>Geo RES</color> of opponents near Lumi will be further decreased by 15%.

10000130.name: Universal Naturalist Archive
10000130.description:
Linnea will increase the Elemental Mastery of certain characters in your party according to your current active character. Increase in Elemental Mastery is based on 5% of Linnea's DEF. If your current active character:
· Is a Moonsign character: Increase this character's Elemental Mastery.
· Is not a Moonsign character: Increase Linnea's own Elemental Mastery.

10000130.name: Moonsign Benediction: Habitat Survey
10000130.description:
When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Linnea has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Linnea is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.

10000130.name: Master Adventurer
10000130.description:
When Linnea is not in combat, the charge time of her <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color> is greatly decreased, and she will shoot an <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color> instead. Different effects will occur depending on the targets hit:
· Specific animals: <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color> will be transformed into a special "Net" that can capture the essence and form of these animals, using them as a medium to manifest the animal's physical form again. The "Net" can only be used for a limited number of times each week. 
· Ore veins used in forging: Linnea will dispatch Lumi, who will quickly strike at the ore marked by the <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color>, then collect the dislodged ore. If Lumi is not on the field, Linnea will summon her for a short duration to help obtain the ore.

The DMG dealt to opponents by Linnea's <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color> is reduced to 20% of her original Charged Arrow. Additionally, after firing a certain number of <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrows</color> within a short period of time, Linnea needs to take a temporary break before she can continue using them.

10000131.name: Allegoria
10000131.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Proclaims a decree in the primordial tongue and performs up to 3 attacks that deal <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Nicole plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Also deals <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

10000131.name: Revelation: Uncreated Light
10000131.description:
Recreates a fleeting glimpse of an age long past, when the angels acted on the authority of the heavens, bestowing the {LINK#N11310001}<color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>{/LINK}{LINK#N11310002}{/LINK} effect on nearby party members. This increases their ATK and deals <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color>, as well as creates a Shield of Blazing Light.
The Shield of Blazing Light's DMG Absorption is based on Nicole's ATK, and it will absorb <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> at 250% effectiveness.

parameterSeries.label: Grace of Kenosis ATK Bonus Ratio
Grace of Kenosis Max ATK Bonus
