10000131.name: Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent
10000131.description:
As Nicole weaves the path of anchored fate with golden threads of light, she deals <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> and switches to Silent Contemplation mode.
In this mode, when nearby active party members hit an opponent, an Arcane Projection is summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG scales based on the corresponding character's ATK and will be considered as having been dealt by them.
This effect can occur once every 3s, and can be triggered up to 4 times each time Nicole switches to Silent Contemplation mode.

It is worth noting that Hexerei characters' Arcane Projections appear to differ somehow in appearance from the others...

10000131.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Light in the Darkness
10000131.description:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: The Role of a Guide...?</color>, Nicole becomes a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
Increases the DMG dealt by Hexerei characters' <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11315}Arcane Projections{/LINK}</color> by 300% of Nicole's ATK.

10000131.name: Methexis
10000131.description:
For 20s after unleashing the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11312}Revelation: Uncreated Light{/LINK}</color>, Nicole will continuously "observe" the other current active party members. After the observed character has remained on the field for 3s, their {LINK#N11310001}<color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>{/LINK} is upgraded to {LINK#N11310002}<color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color>{/LINK}, increasing their ATK by an additional 300. If the observed character is a Hexerei character, <color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color> is upgraded to <color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color> straight away.
When characters other than Nicole who have <color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color> leave the field, their effect reverts to <color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>.

10000131.name: Philokalia
10000131.description: When Elemental DMG from nearby active party members hits an opponent, Nicole's own {LINK#N11310001}<color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>{/LINK} effect is upgraded to {LINK#N11310002}<color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color>{/LINK} for 8s.

10000131.name: Nepsis
10000131.description:
When you are in Teyvat and not in combat, Nicole's Charged Attack becomes "Emissarial Guidance" if you have already obtained the current region's Treasure Compass. Emissarial Guidance: Calls upon nearby Seelie to show the way, triggering an effect similar to the region's Treasure Compass.
This effect has a cooldown time of 5 seconds and does not work in Domains, Trounce Domains, and the Spiral Abyss.

10000132.name: Badaboom! Hexbuster Hammer
10000132.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 attacks by swinging the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and performs an upward hammer swing, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> to opponents in front.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

10000132.name: Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime
10000132.description:
Determined to take down the "evil" witch and save her beloved Descartes, Prune unleashes the power of the wind! She strikes at the Witchlure Bell using her Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.
If Prune triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction in the opponent with this attack, her <color=#FFD780FF>Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime</color> is changed to <color=#FFD780FF>Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!</color> for the next 6s.

<color=#FFD780FF>Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!</color>
Ensconces the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} in the element involved in the earlier Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction. After tapping to unleash, Prune will launch a midair kick at the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing DMG to opponents in front of her of the corresponding elemental type.

10000132.name: The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!
10000132.description:
Prune gently swings the Witchlure Bell, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> to nearby opponents. After this, the Bell will enter the Hunter-Seeker mode.

<color=#FFD780FF>Witchlure Bell: Hunter-Seeker</color>
In this mode, the Witchlure Bell will follow the current active character, attacking surrounding opponents at intervals and dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

10000132.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Witchseeker's Vow
10000132.description:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: Of What Is Contested</color>, Prune becomes a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
After a Hexerei character in the party affected by the Tolling Rally effect triggers an Elemental Reaction on an opponent, Prune's ATK is increased by 60% for 5s. If the Elemental Reaction triggered is a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, the triggering character's ATK will additionally be increased by 30% for 5s.

10000132.name: Verdict and Punishment
10000132.description: During the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color>, after the Witchlure Bell in Hunter-Seeker mode deals DMG to an opponent, if this DMG triggers Swirl or Stellar Swirl in an opponent, it will also summon a {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that will deal 150% of Prune's ATK as DMG to them, with the DMG Type matching the Elemental Conversion from the Swirl or Stellar Swirl. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

10000132.name: Tolling Synchronicity
10000132.description: After Prune hits an opponent with the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion, other nearby party members will gain the Tolling Rally effect for 5s: When Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts deal DMG to opponents, that attack's DMG will be increased based on the portion of Prune's ATK in excess of 2,000 when they become affected by the Tolling Rally effect. Every excess ATK point increases that instance of DMG by 0.025%, up to a total of 50% max.

10000132.name: Tinker-Tink, Clank, and Bang!
10000132.description: Has a 10% chance to get 1 regional Character Talent Material (base material excluded) when crafting. The rarity is the same as the resulting material.

10000133.name: Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition
10000133.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Generates threads that control her weapon using formulae, performing up to 3 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Summons the Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache, or "<color=#FFD780FF>Fagio</color>," and switches it to <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode: Unleashes a sweeping fire attack on enemies in front, as well as periodically fires condensed beams, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: The condensed beams will instead deal <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
While in <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> will continuously increase. Firing condensed beams will also further increase its Decoding Power.
When Fagio's Decoding Power reaches the maximum of 100 points, it switches to <color=#FFD780FF>Power Overdrive</color> mode, in which it fires at opponents with longer intervals, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. It will be unable to switch to Decoding mode at this time.
When not in <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> gradually decreases. When Sandrone is off-field, she will focus on maintaining Fagio, causing its Decoding Power to decrease at 300% the original rate.
Fagio exits <color=#FFD780FF>Power Overdrive</color> mode when its <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> has decreased to under 50.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from midair to strike the ground below, dealing DMG to opponents along their path and causing AoE DMG on landing.

parameterSeries.label: Charged Attack Condensed Beam Stellar-Conduct DMG
Charged Attack Condensed Beam Stellar Swirl DMG

10000133.name: Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis
10000133.description:
With her impeccable, ladylike poise, Sandrone boards the <color=#FFD780FF>Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech</color> and hovers forward for 6s. During this time, Sandrone can control the travel direction of the craft. Pressing Sprint consumes 10 Stamina and launches her into an elegant high-speed hover mode, in which she will move even faster at the cost of 15 Stamina per second.

When Sandrone starts hovering, if there are opponents nearby, she will also summon a Prismatic Resonance Cannon and fire 2 Prism Shots at any opponents who have yet to cool down, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>.
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: The second Prism Shot will instead deal <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

When on the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech, Sandrone will also elegantly and quietly repair Fagio, causing <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> to swiftly decrease.

10000133.name: Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.
10000133.description:
In line with established ladylike behavior, Sandrone summons a large number of Prismatic Resonance Cannons for a frontal bombardment before firing on her foes with a Convective Inhibition Ray, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: The Convective Inhibition Ray instead deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

parameterSeries.label: Convective Inhibition Ray Stellar Swirl DMG

10000133.name: Eternal Speculation Engine
10000133.description:
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: When using the Elemental Skill {LINK#S11332}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis</color>{/LINK}, if Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> is greater than 50, the second Prism Shot fired by Fagio at nearby opponents will deal 400% of its original DMG as Fagio's Decoding Power is decreased.
Additionally, for every 10 points of <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> Fagio loses, it gains 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Refined Tactics</color> for 60s (max 10 stacks). When Sandrone uses the Elemental Burst {LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.</color>{/LINK} while in the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color> state, all stacks of Refined Tactics are cleared, causing the Convective Inhibition Ray to deal 100% + (number of stacks cleared) × 10% of its original DMG.

10000133.name: A Lady's Code of Conduct
10000133.description: Increases Sandrone's Elemental Mastery based on her ATK. Every 100 ATK will increase her Elemental Mastery by 8. The maximum increase she can gain this way is 160.

10000133.name: Stellar Jubilee: Light of Rationalisme
10000133.description:
Sandrone will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when she is inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}, or the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of the aforementioned reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Sandrone's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.

10000133.name: A Caucus Prelude and a Long Tale
10000133.description: When Sandrone is in the party, you will gain additional snack rewards after turning in your Daily Commissions with Katheryne.

10000136.name: Chain Reaction
10000136.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs a maximum of 3 attacks that deal <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to the area in front after a short casting time.
Mitya will instead perform the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Detonation</color>, which consumes no Stamina, if a <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core: Overload{/LINK}</color> created by Mitya himself is currently on the field and he has at least 1 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color>: Deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to the area in front and continuously consumes <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacons</color> while held. Each <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> consumed deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to the area in front that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> upon impact.

10000136.name: Principle: Variable Detection
10000136.description:
Conducts a theoretically relatively safe experiment at a theoretically relatively safe yield, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and creating a <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> in different ways depending on whether the Skill is tapped or held.

Tapping the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color> again within 6s after using it changes the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color>'s state. The Detection Core's state can be changed in this way every 1.5s.

parameterSeries.label: Steady State Core Gradient Beacon Consumption DMG

10000136.name: Analysis: Gradient Theory
10000136.description: Let the elements burst forth like inspiration itself! Deals <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and creates 3 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color>.

10000136.name: Baseline Stress Test
Explosive Reagent: Safe Limits Exceeded
10000136.description: The duration of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> is increased to 10s. Additionally, Mitya's CRIT Rate increases by 5% for 15s after creating a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color>. This effect can stack up to 4 times.

10000136.name: Stellar Jubilee: Top-Secret Protocol
10000136.description:
When party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct. Stellar-Conduct reactions will no longer create <color=#FFD780FF>Starlight Prisms</color>, and will instead create 1 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color> nearby every 1.5s for 3s. These Beacons can be carried by Mitya and transform the area around them into an even larger <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>. Triggering another Stellar-Conduct reaction will refresh the duration of the aforementioned effects.
Additionally, the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by all nearby party members will be increased based on Mitya's Elemental Mastery: Every point of Elemental Mastery he has increases Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.028%. The maximum Base DMG increase that can be gained this way is 14%. While within a <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>, Mitya will also enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state.

10000136.name: Energy Catalysis
10000136.description:
When destructible rocks are nearby, <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core: Steady State{/LINK}</color> can quickly clear them.
Additionally, when Mitya is in the party, creating <color=#FFD780FF>Prime Ice Construct: Basic Heat Source</color> does not consume Kresnik Energy.

10000137.name: Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield
10000137.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to leap forward and slam the ground, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
When Valeriy has at least 40 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>, he will consume all <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> to instead perform the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.{LINK#N11370002}{/LINK}

10000137.name: Active Defense: Bastion Charge
10000137.description:
Valeriy raises his shield cannon and charges forward, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>, gaining 40 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>, and deploying a Supercharged Shield.
The Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption scales with Valeriy's ATK, and has 250% absorption efficiency against <color=#FFACFFFF></color>Electro DMG<color=#FFACFFFF></color>.

10000137.name: Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo
10000137.description: Deals <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to nearby opponents and fires a <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shell</color> high into the air. The <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shell</color> disperses into a barrage of projectiles that rain down, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to nearby opponents.

10000137.name: Advance With the Creeping Barrage
10000137.description: Valeriy gains 5 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> whenever another nearby active character in the party hits an opponent with an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> attack while the <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shells</color> from his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30605}Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo{/LINK}</color> are falling. He can gain up to 80 <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> in this way after each use of his Elemental Burst.

10000137.name: Into the Breach
10000137.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370002}Offensive Directive{/LINK}</color> is enhanced based on the amount of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> consumed when performing his special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color>. Each point consumed further increases the DMG Bonus granted by <color=#FFD780FF>Offensive Directive</color>. If Valeriy is:
·In the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state: Each point of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> consumed increases this DMG Bonus by an amount equal to 0.9% of Valeriy's ATK;
·Not in the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state: Each point of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> consumed increases this DMG Bonus by an amount equal to 0.3% of Valeriy's ATK.

10000137.name: Subzero Conditioning
10000137.description: Valeriy enters the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state while within a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}.

10000137.name: Tundra Operational Intelligence
10000137.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Snezhnaya (not including Nod-Krai) Expedition for 20 hours.

10000140.name: Psyshkhwe Arietta
10000140.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Sings an ancient song of the Water Imps, unleashing up to 4 strikes. This deals <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> to the opponent.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a water ball forward, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

10000140.name: Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn
10000140.description:
Reveals her true Water Imp form, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> and gaining the <color=#FFD780FF>Song of Ages Past</color> effect: While this effect is active, Vodyanitsa summons the ancient <color=#FFD780FF>Horn of Spring's Call</color>, periodically moving closer to an opponent in a swift movement to attack them, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>.
The above two types of attacks will also decrease the <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro RES</color> and <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> of opponents hit. Additionally, while the <color=#FFD780FF>Song of Ages Past</color> effect is active, your active character gains increased resistance to interruption and periodically regenerates HP based on Vodyanitsa's Max HP.

parameterSeries.label: Horn of Spring's Call Attack Interval
Song of Ages Past Healing Interval

10000140.name: Koda: Sink With Thee
10000140.description:
Leads a song of the Water Imps which lures its listeners to their doom. This deals <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> to the opponent.
When in the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> state, DMG dealt is further increased.

parameterSeries.label: Song of Ages Past DMG Bonus

10000140.name: The Last Djeguako Songstress
10000140.description:
When the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> is used, any Stellar Vortex on the field will turn into a Wandering Vortex instead. While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> effect is active, nearby party members' Stellar Swirl reactions will generate Wandering Vortex instead.
Generating or detonating a Wandering Vortex will also reduce nearby opponents' <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo RES</color> by 35% for 6s. 
Additionally, nearby party members who enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state while <color=#FFD780FF>Song of Ages Past</color> is in effect will have the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state extended by 4s.

10000140.name: Dirge of the Fandyr
10000140.description:
When the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> is used, Vodyanitsa will also gain 25 stacks of {LINK#N11400001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lead Vocal</color>{/LINK} as well as 10 stacks of {LINK#N11400002}<color=#FFD780FF>Chorus</color>{/LINK}.
The two effects above last 30s each, and the stack count is refreshed when the Elemental Skill is used.

10000140.name: Echoes Over the Frozen Lake
10000140.description:
Holding the Elemental Skill outside of combat will cause Vodyanitsa to embody her true Water Imp form and swim for up to 10s at the cost of Stamina. Naturally, as a Water Imp, she can also move across the water's surface. Vodyanitsa will exit her Water Imp form when the Elemental Skill is used again, when the duration ends, or when all Stamina is depleted.
Additionally, while Vodyanitsa can swim faster, her Stamina consumption rate is also increased.

10000140.name: Heartless Siren Song
10000140.description: As the Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe, Vodyanitsa sings in person in place of playing an instrument.

10000143.name: Vila Blade Dance
10000143.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 6 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to trample opponents in front of her.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along her path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000143.name: The Art of Victory
10000143.description:
Calls forth Spirit Blades passed down through generations of the Vila to deal <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>, then switches to the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430001}Armed for Action{/LINK}</color> mode and gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430002}Sword Essence{/LINK}</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Armed for Action</color>
DMG dealt by Vesna with her Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks become <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion instead. She will also summon a wind pinion that attacks the opponent at the same time, dealing additional <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>. Each time the wind pinion is summoned, Vesna will regenerate a certain amount of <color=#FFD780FF>Sword Essence</color>.
Vesna can consume <color=#FFD780FF>Sword Essence</color> to unleash the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430003}Windborne Sword{/LINK}</color>, which deals to the opponent <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.
Each use of the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Windborne Sword</color> in the same instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Armed for Action</color> will increase the level of <color=#FFD780FF>Windborne Sword</color>, beginning from Lv. 1 to Lv. 3 max, for more <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>. Using <color=#FFD780FF>Windborne Sword</color> at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3 will also summon <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430004}Spirit Blades{/LINK}</color> which deal <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.
Vesna will exit the mode when its duration ends or when she has used <color=#FFD780FF>Windborne Sword</color> at the highest level 3 times. Exiting will clear all remaining <color=#FFD780FF>Sword Essence</color> she has accrued.
Additionally, when in this mode, Vesna's resistance to interruption is increased.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: DMG dealt with the <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Blades</color> becomes <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> that is also considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG.

parameterSeries.label: Windborne Sword Lv. 2 Spirit Blade DMG
Windborne Sword Lv. 3 Spirit Blade DMG
Windborne Sword Lv. 3 Spirit Blade Final Hit DMG
Windborne Sword Lv. 2 Spirit Blade Stellar Swirl DMG
Windborne Sword Lv. 3 Spirit Blade Stellar Swirl DMG
Windborne Sword Lv. 3 Spirit Blade Final Hit Stellar Swirl DMG

10000143.name: For the Tsaritsa!
10000143.description: Summons multiple <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430004}Spirit Blades{/LINK}</color>, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>. Also gains a stack of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430002}Sword Essence{/LINK}</color>.

10000143.name: Rite of Spring's Procession
10000143.description:
After Vesna uses the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430003}Windborne Sword{/LINK}</color> or the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11435}For the Tsaritsa!{/LINK}</color>, she also gains 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Disciplinary Action</color> which lasts 20s. Max 6 stacks, and the duration of each stack is independent of the others'.
When she has <color=#FFD780FF>Disciplinary Action</color> stacks active, the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430004}Spirit Blades{/LINK}</color> summoned by Vesna will deal DMG equal to (100% + 10% × Disciplinary Action stack count) of the original DMG instead. All active stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>Disciplinary Action</color> are cleared when Vesna uses the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>The Art of Victory</color> or when she leaves the field.

10000143.name: Truth Prevails
10000143.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Vesna will gain the corresponding effect based on the Elemental Type of her party members: 
· For every <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> or <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color> character in her current party, Vesna's ATK increases by 6%; and
· For every character of all other Elemental Types in her current party, Vesna's Elemental Mastery increases by 25 instead.

10000143.name: Stellar Jubilee: Splendid Prelude
10000143.description:
When party members trigger Cryo Swirl, it will be changed to a Stellar Swirl reaction, and party members' Base DMG for the Stellar Swirl will be increased based on Vesna's ATK. Every 100 ATK she has increases the Base Stellar Swirl DMG by 0.7%. The maximum DMG increase that can be gained this way is 14%.
After a party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction nearby, Vesna enters the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s.

10000143.name: The Grand Circuit
10000143.description:
Holding on Sprint or Jump when Vesna is not in combat will cause her to enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Coursing</color> state.

<color=#FFD780FF>Coursing</color>
Continuously consumes Stamina to hover in mid-air. Sprinting or tapping Jump to go higher expends additional Stamina. Including the hold on Jump that triggers <color=#FFD780FF>Coursing</color>, Vesna can go higher up to 3 times in each instance of the <color=#FFD780FF>Coursing</color> state.

Additionally, in Snezhnaya (excluding Nod-Krai), when Vesna is switched onto the field while the currently active party member is in mid-air and not in combat, she will immediately enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Coursing</color> state and regenerate 50 Stamina. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

10000148.name: Skirmishing Spear
10000148.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes and applies the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} to the opponent hit by the final strike.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents in his path.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

10000148.name: Thunderbolt Strike
10000148.description: Follows his hunter's instincts. Tap or hold to produce different effects as well as apply the {LINK#N11480001}Hunter's Mark{/LINK} effect to the hit opponents. Tapping Fires at opponents in front of him, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Holding Enters aiming mode, then targets opponents within a certain area in front of him. Alyosha's Interruption RES is enhanced when in this mode. At the end of the button hold, he deals Electro DMG to the targeted opponents. The reckless hunter once reached for the spear's edge, and it was only after they survived a lesson paid in blood that they came to understand the harsh truths of survival on the frozen plains.

10000148.name: Hunter's Advance
10000148.description: Summons his trusted companion Tugarin to fight alongside him on the field. This also turns an area in front of him into a Fulgurite Hunting Field for a short time. Fulgurite Hunting Field · Continuously taunts nearby opponents to incite them to attack. · Every 2s, deals an instance of AoE Electro DMG to any opponent that enters the field. Tugarin · If there are any opponents nearby, Tugarin will quickly move close to an opponent and maul them every 2s, dealing Electro DMG. · If an opponent affected by the Hunter's Mark effect is hit, the Hunter's Mark will also be activated. · Where there are multiple opponents, Tugarin will attack those affected by the Hunter's Mark effect first. Wait. Keep waiting until the impatience fades. That's when the red-bellied plover shall sweep across the birch grove and present itself before one's arrow.

10000148.name: Awakened by the Baying Hounds
10000148.description: When {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks, it will also restore HP to nearby active characters at 120% of Alyosha's ATK.

10000148.name: Suffer the Winter Wheat Will
10000148.description: Increases the DMG Alyosha deals with his Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst by 0.35% for every 1% of his Energy Recharge. Up to a 70% increase can be obtained in this way.

10000148.name: Into the Fray
10000148.description:
Alyosha will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained when the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} is activated will also increase Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by the character when on the field by 20%.

10000148.name: Treetop Watch
10000148.description: Displays the location of nearby <color=#FFD780FF>resources unique to Snezhnaya</color> on the mini-map, and this effect also applies in the Shadow Realm.

10000150.name: Snow Swan Variation
10000150.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Unleashes a sword attack of up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a dazzling slash on opponents in front of her.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Attacks opponents in her path while plunging from mid-air, then deals AoE DMG upon landing.

10000150.name: Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers
10000150.description:
With slow, graceful dance steps, Odette deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to the opponent, and also summons her {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} to the field.
If a <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> summoned by Odette is already on the field, this will re-summon the Dance Double and reset its duration.

<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>
Alternates between the <color=#FFD780FF>Plume</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Wing</color> dance moves, periodically attacking nearby opponents and dealing to them <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color>, Odette's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color> will become the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}{LINK#N11500004}{/LINK} instead, where a dance duet deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to nearby opponents over time. Then, when the duet ends, she deals another instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG.

parameterSeries.label: Coda at Dawn's Tolling Stellar-Conduct/Stellar Swirl DMG

10000150.name: Presto: Bluebird Finale
10000150.description:
With quick, lively dance steps, Odette deals multiple instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>, and summons her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11500001}Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK}. She also gains <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan's Dream</color>, which increases the Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG Odette deals.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Presto: Bluebird Finale</color>, Odette's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color> will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}{LINK#N11500004}{/LINK} instead.

If there is a Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette on the field, it will be summoned to her side with its duration refreshed.

parameterSeries.label: Snow Swan's Dream Stellar Glimmer Reaction DMG Bonus

10000150.name: Spring Rite of the Chosen One
10000150.description: When Odette summons her {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK}, she also obtains 4 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}.

10000150.name: Pathetique of Pateticheskaya
10000150.description: For every 100 ATK Odette has over 1,000, her Stellar Glimmer DMG is additionally increased by 1.5% of the original DMG. She can deal up to 30% more additional DMG in this way.

10000150.name: Stellar Jubilee: Dance of Aurore
10000150.description:
Odette will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when she is inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}, or the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Odette's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.

10000150.name: Echo of Winter Daydreams
10000150.description:
Shows the locations of <color=#FFD780FF>Snezhnaya's Local Specialties</color> on the mini-map, and this effect also applies in the Shadow Realm.
Practicing dance in one's spare time might even trigger other effects...
